Monthly closing day for Dec 2026 not found – Lotte Jamsil closed Mon 12 Oct and Mon 9 Nov, so a Monday closure (30 Nov or 7 Dec) is possible; check lotteshopping.com or call 1577-0001. Winter sale runs 13–29 Nov 2026 (ends before the trip). 'Lotte Town Light' media facade on the exterior runs from December. Lotte Duty Free is on 9F–12F.
